description: This file contains a struct 'AssistantTextSegment' for representing segments of assistant text, as well as an enum 'AssistantTextParser' that provides static methods for parsing raw strings into segments, handling tags like <think> and <final> to distinguish between thinking and response parts. It appears to be part of a UI-related component, specifically for parsing and rendering assistant reply segments with special tags.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of assistant text, with an identifier, a kind (thinking or response), and the text content.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses a raw string into an array of AssistantTextSegment, optionally including or excluding 'thinking' segments based on tags.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns segments that are visible for UI display, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks if there is any visible content in the raw string, considering whether to include 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks if there is any visible content, excluding 'thinking' segments by default.
